subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should OpenClaw land this focused fresh-session fallback for accepted non-transient gateway disconnects now, or pause it for the broader reattach-first behavior tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The code review can verify the narrow same-session collision fix, but only maintainers can decide whether the remaining two-run model/tool and possible `--deliver` side effects are acceptable for this disconnect boundary.

options.title: Land focused fix first
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook fallback boundary for this rare disconnect and keep the reattach-first redesign as the follow-up issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and ask the contributor to implement the broader wait/reattach-first design before merging this behavior path.

options.title: Reject recook fallback for accepted runs
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers decide accepted gateway runs must never trigger a local recook path after disconnect.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook fallback boundary for this rare disconnect and keep the reattach-first redesign as the follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest sampled history in the CLI agent/gateway command path that owns this fallback decision.
